title: Machine learning predicts entropy formation ability of multicomponent REPO4 environmental barrier coatings
summary: A machine-learning model trained on DFT-computed entropy formation ability (EFA) predicted xenotime-phase stability of multicomponent rare-earth phosphates better than geometric descriptors such as mean cation radius and cation size disorder. High-EFA compositions formed single-phase xenotime when synthesised and checked by XRD, while low-EFA ones gave mixed or monazite phases. Model type, metrics and the number of synthesised compositions were not read; labels derive from DFT.
ai_technology: Machine-learning model trained on DFT-computed entropy formation ability

evidence.tested: Held-out higher-order compositions plus synthesis and XRD of selected compositions.
evidence.unknown: Model type, metrics and number of compositions tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The model predicted which compositions stabilise the xenotime phase.
